title: Houthis say targeted Saudi oil giant Aramco, vow more attacks
summary: Yemen's Houthis said Wednesday they had targeted facilities belonging to Saudi Aramco, after Saudi officials reported a strike on a building in an area housing the energy giant's operations center.
